items.title: Live: Government to cut 160,000 people from NDIS scheme as budget blows out
items.description: NDIS Minister Mark Butler says the scheme was designed to support 410,000 people with a disability, but currently supports 760,000. Follow live.

items.title: Live: ASX tumbles as Cochlear shares crash 40pc to 10-year low
items.description: One of Australia's biggest companies, Cochlear, has rattled investors by slashing its profit outlook, while the broader market drops. Follow live.

items.title: US senator 'tremendously concerned' after navy moves assets from Pacific
items.description: The US's Indo-Pacific commander praises work to upgrade Australia's AUKUS base, but says he needs more naval firepower in the region as China rapidly expands its military.

items.title: Live: Iran says Trump's ceasefire extension a 'ploy to buy time' as Vance cancels Pakistan trip
items.description: US President Donald Trump says he is extending the ceasefire with Iran. Follow live.

items.title: How Trump went from 'I expect to be bombing' to 'I extend the ceasefire'
items.description: The Iran war ceasefire has been extended but no-one is quite sure on the new deadline, Middle East correspondent Matthew Doran writes.

items.title: Gaza conditions 'catastrophic' as report finds $US71b needed to rebuild
items.description: More than $US71 billion will be needed over the next 10 years for recovery and reconstruction in Gaza, according to a new report by the European Union and the United Nations.

items.title: Iran's meme factory is using 'the weapons of their enemy' to embarrass Trump
items.description: AI-generated Lego memes criticising the conflict in the Middle East and mocking Donald Trump are attracting a large audience online as a new front opens in the Iran war.

items.title: The growing problem stopping Melbourne residents using their microwaves
items.description: A power company warns that growing electricity demand is creating an undervoltage issue as Victoria's infrastructure struggles to keep up with the transition from gas.

items.title: Former minister threatened developers over working with CFMEU, inquiry told
items.description: The Commission of Inquiry into the CFMEU is told Grace Grace "made it clear" she expected the developers to cooperate with the union, or she would consider terminating their contract.

items.title: How young boys helped Australians wage guerilla war against Japan in Timor
items.description: Incredible bonds were formed between Australian commandos and Timorese boys during World War II. The White Australia policy meant they had to say goodbye when the Anzacs departed.

items.title: Charities struggle to stay open as food insecurity rises
items.description: Charities that provide food say they are running at full capacity, forcing some to close and others to rethink how they deliver meals.

items.title: Travel giant's $240m overcharging scandal balloons to claims of fake agreements
items.description: Brisbane-based Corporate Travel Management has detailed a laundry list of concerns about a ballooning scandal, including reliance on potentially fake documents.

items.title: Tim Picton's accused killer pleads guilty over separate assault
items.description: A man who allegedly killed Labor identity Tim Picton in Perth admits assaulting another man in Kalamunda just days earlier.

items.title: South Sydney might never get a better chance to end the longest NRL hoodoo
items.description: The Rabbitohs have never won a game in Melbourne in almost three decades of trying but they might never get a better chance than this weekend.

items.title: The Michael Jackson biopic is as generic as its subject was singular
items.description: Spanning from the Jackson 5's 1960s discovery through to the height of his fame in the late 80s, Michael skates over the more challenging aspects of the King of Pop.

items.title: Aussie junior 'obsessed' with golf set to test his skills overseas
items.description: Alby Weyden was two years old when he became obsessed with golf. Four years on, his family hopes to raise enough money for him to compete in the Canadian Invitational.

items.title: 'It's been horrible': Your experiences with family estrangement
items.description: Our recent stories about the grief of family estrangement resonated strongly. Here's how some Australians have been affected by it.

items.title: NRL hit man who suffered 50 concussions says impact of new rules unclear
items.description: Junior rugby league clubs and neuroscientists have welcomed changes to address growing concerns around injuries but say more should be done to protect children.

items.title: $50/hour charge for older Australians to shower reversed by government after six months
items.description: The decision to scrap the plan to charge older Australians $50/hour for showers was made after months of sustained criticism, including warnings that people were forgoing other care to afford the service.

items.title: 15yo among five charged over alleged kidnapping of rapper's bodyguard
items.description: Four men and a teenage boy are set to front court today over the alleged assault and kidnapping of a bodyguard for rapper and alleged Alameddine associate Ali Younes.

items.title: 'How many beers have you had?' Flood evacuees claim racial profiling
items.description: Flood evacuees from remote Northern Territory communities say they are being "treated like prisoners" by security guards working at their emergency accommodation centre.

items.title: Staff face misconduct proceedings after foster kids allowed to live with killer
items.description: Some Department of Communities and Justice staff members will face misconduct proceedings after a bungle that saw two foster children living with triple killer Regina Arthurell earlier this year.

items.title: Group says site of new greyhound track should be for housing
items.description: The council and a community group fought against it, but Orange is set to get a new greyhound racing track after the project was approved by the Western Regional Planning Panel.

items.title: NSW welcomes back superstar, hands Origin debut to Dragons gun
items.description: The Sky Blues welcome back Millie Elliott for the 2025 Women's State of Origin series opener, while Emma Verran's pregnancy opens up a spot for Teagan Berry to make her debut.

items.title: Recordings point to second Queensland population of rare night parrot
items.description: Ecologists say thousands of hours of audio recordings have detected night parrot calls in south-west Queensland.
